nodes.name: Episteme vs. doxa
nodes.title: The known unknown
sourceNotes: — the two words this entry is named for, at the place they were separated. Socrates does not define doxa, he asks a question about a person: the man who loves beautiful things but will not hear of beauty itself — **is he awake, or dreaming?** And dreaming is defined as *taking a likeness for the thing it resembles*, asleep or awake. That is the whole of "confident hallucination" in one image, and it is why the anti-pattern here is not-knowing-that-you-don't-know rather than lying: the dreamer is sincere. Knowledge and belief are then split by what they admit — knowledge only what is true, belief both true and false — which is the asymmetry the practical rule prices.

edges.why: [wabi-sabi is traced to Taoist ideas of the Song dynasty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wabi-sabi) and changed as it was transmitted to Japan, taking on Zen practice on arrival. The Taoist vessel was complete as an argument about objects; what the Japanese movement went searching for was a way to live inside it — a tea room, a repaired bowl, a stance — and it had to build its own vocabulary to do that.

the Wachowskis [named their cyberspace after the one in *Neuromancer*](https://www.syfy.com/syfy-wire/7-classic-sci-fi-influences-on-the-original-the-matrix), and Gibson, watching it, put the distance in one line: it was more Dick's than his, *"thematically gnostic, something 'Neuromancer' isn't"*. That is the succession in the author's own words — the earlier vessel was complete and the newer film was not extending it, it was searching somewhere else with the same equipment.

the line is documented at both ends. [Takeuchi and Nonaka's 1986 paper](https://hbr.org/1986/01/the-new-new-product-development-game) coined the word *Scrum* from observing Honda, Canon and Epson — Japanese manufacturing, watched by two management scholars — and [Poppendieck's *Lean Software Development* (2003)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lean_software_development) translated Ohno's system into seven principles for software teams. Lean's vessel was complete as a manufacturing practice; what Agile went searching for was a vessel for work whose output is not a physical unit.

earned 2026-08-14, and the source states it in the strongest available form: the [Manifesto for Software Craftsmanship](https://manifesto.softwarecraftsmanship.org/) does not merely follow the Agile Manifesto, it **extends each of its values line by line** — *"not only working software, but also well-crafted software"*. [Robert C. Martin signed both](https://www.informit.com/articles/article.aspx?p=1743276), and the stated motive was that Agile practice had drifted toward iteration management and away from engineering. Agile's vessel was complete as a way of *deciding what to build next*; what this movement went searching for was one for what is inside the increment.

earned 2026-08-14, and it is not an inference from the name: the movement began **inside the Agile conference**. Patrick Debois took his *"agile infrastructure"* question to an ad-hoc birds-of-a-feather session at [Agile 2008 in Toronto](https://devops.com/the-origins-of-devops-whats-in-a-name/), proposed by Andrew Shafer, and one person came — the two of them. The question he brought was **how to make operations as agile as the developers already were**, which is Agile's own vessel held up to a room it did not reach. He ran the first devopsdays a year later, and the word was coined there.

the Composer's reading, and the corpus had already recorded the pair without naming it: *Component contract as executable spec* binds Design Engineer ↔ QA Engineer, and *Semantic naming & i18n as governed vocabulary* binds Design Engineer ↔ Content Designer. A design token and a published endpoint are **the same object** — a named, versioned promise between a producer and a consumer who never meet. Neither movement descends from the other; both went looking for a vessel for the same boundary and each built its own.

and this is the pair that forced the edge kind. **SRE did not come from DevOps.** Google was running it from **2003**; DevOps was named in **2009**. Google's own formulation is [*"class SRE implements DevOps"*](https://sre.google/workbook/how-sre-relates/) — an interface and one implementation of it, not a parent and a child. Two movements, the same boundary, different vessels, overlapping in time.
